breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly specifies only 'an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half-shift (offset = 1 1 1 in Quantum ESPRESSO notation)' and makes no mention of gamma-centering anywhere. This matches the ground truth, which removes the contradictory gamma-centered instruction and retains only the half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid.
